description: This file defines the MonthlyProrationService class responsible for handling billing proration logic, including creating, processing, and retrying proration records, interacting with Stripe API, and managing billing data for teams and organizations.

classes.name: MonthlyProrationService
classes.description: Service class managing billing proration, invoice creation, and subscription updates for teams and organizations.

methods.name: processMonthlyProrations
methods.description: Processes proration for a batch of teams for a given month, creating proration records and invoices as needed.

methods.name: createProrationForTeam
methods.description: Creates a proration record for a specific team, calculating the proration, creating invoice items, and updating billing.

methods.name: calculateProration
methods.description: Calculates the prorated amount and remaining days based on subscription and seat changes.

methods.name: createStripeInvoiceItem
methods.description: Creates a Stripe invoice item for the proration and finalizes the invoice.

methods.name: handleInvoiceCreationFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during invoice creation, updating proration status, and cleaning up Stripe artifacts.

methods.name: handleProrationPaymentSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful payment of a proration, updating subscription seats and proration status.

methods.name: handleProrationPaymentFailure
methods.description: Handles failed proration payments, updating status and retry count.

methods.name: retryFailedProration
methods.description: Retries a failed proration by voiding previous invoice and creating a new invoice item.

methods.name: ensureBillingDataPopulated
methods.description: Ensures billing data is populated from Stripe, creating or updating billing records.

methods.name: getSubscriptionQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the current subscription seat quantity from Stripe.
